_comment: Template .mcp.json MCP server baseline for a client project. Copy into the client repo as .mcp.json (or merge into an existing one), replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with that project's real, per-client values, and remove this _comment key before committing — it is documentation only, not a Claude Code setting. Never commit a real URL, token, or client secret in this file's place — see docs/MCP-Setup.md.

project-tracker._comment: Example remote MCP server for a Jira/Azure-DevOps-style issue tracker. Replace url/headers with the client project's actual MCP endpoint and auth scheme.

team-wiki._comment: Example remote MCP server for a Confluence/SharePoint-wiki-style documentation source.

local-tooling._comment: Example local (stdio) MCP server launched as a subprocess — no network credential needed in this file, but any token the tool itself requires should come from an environment variable, never a literal value here.
